# Crayon (CRS) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (distilled from real calls)

## Corpus summary
This KB is built from the transcribed WhatsApp-audio sales calls in the `transcripts/` set. Of 259 transcripts, **141 are substantive** (>=200 chars); the rest are short fragments/voicemails. Of the substantive ones, roughly **129 are Crayon sales/quotation calls** and about **12 are internal logistics/billing coordination** (vehicle, crane, unloading, GST/delivery-address). **Every substantive transcript belongs to Crayon (CRS)** — the calls repeatedly self-identify as "crayon roofing" and "crayon wallet"; none mention Bharat/BSC. The BSC OneDrive folder is a separate set of phone "Call recording" files that were not transcribed here, so this corpus is effectively 100% Crayon.

Honest note on depth: these are mostly **inbound web/phone enquiries** (customers found the number on the website, Google, or YouTube) plus **outbound relationship calls** pushing Tata welding-rod/screws to fabricators. They are strong on *quoting mechanics, product ladder and price levels* and weaker on *full closes* — most calls end with "send it on WhatsApp / I'll check with MD." Treat prices as indicative snapshots from early-to-mid July 2026, not a rate card.

## Products & brand ladder
Crayon is an **authorized distributor of JSW and Tata**, operating out of Manali, Chennai (office at Andarkuppam; own godown). Core lines:

**JSW colour-coated steel (roofing coil & profiled sheet) — the brand ladder, best to cheapest:**
- **Color On Plus** — top branded product, **15-year warranty**, AZ150 / aluminium-zinc 150 coating. "color on plus-ல warranty உன்னாயி sir, 15 years" [Color On Plus carries 15-year warranty].
- **Silver On / Silveron** — branded, warranty, "branded product மாதிரி, price கொஞ்சம் ஜாஸ்தி" [branded-like, priced a bit higher].
- **JSW Steel (bare, AZ150)** — same AZ150 coating but bare, cheaper, **no warranty**: "Silveron இல்லாம Bare-ல... warranty கிடைக்காது steel-ல, Silver-ல warranty கிடைக்கும்" [without Silveron it's bare; no warranty on Steel, warranty on Silver].
- **Pragathi Plus** — mid tier.
- **Radiance** — cheapest JSW line, **no 15-year warranty**, ~₹10/sqm cheaper: "Radiance... rate கம்மி ₹10 கம்மி square meter" and "Radiance... it will not come warranty."
- **Asian / Indradhanush** — cheapest colour brand: "Asian தான் அவ்ளோ கம்மியா குடுப்பாங்க" [only Asian goes that cheap]. Also **CFG** colour stock referenced.

Thickness sold: 0.45 / 0.47 / 0.5 / 0.6 mm; coating quoted as GSM (150) and by aluminium content ("Color On aluminium is including 150... Pragathi-ல 70 தான்" — the coating spec is the real difference between grades). Colours in stock talk: Sky Blue, Off-White, White, Snow Grey, Mist/Mr Green, "environmental green."

**Insulated / speciality roofing:**
- **Puff (PUF sandwich) panels** — 30 / 40 / 50 mm; "roofing வந்து 50 mm... wall-க்கு cladding panel 30 mm."
- **Polycarbonate** — Lexon brand, 1.5 / 1.8 / 2 mm, transparent/white.
- **JSW flashing.**

**Tata distribution (14 districts):** Electra **welding electrodes/rods**, **self-drilling screws** (3/4 inch up to 130 mm), cutting/grinding/buffing wheels, emery.

**Also traded:** MS tube (Tata commercial), SS (Jindal dealership, 202/304), fencing.

Crayon **supplies material only** — repeatedly: "supply மட்டும் தான் பண்ணுவோம், fixing நாங்க பண்ண மாட்டோம்" [we only supply, we don't do fixing/fabrication].

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in Crayon calls)
**Colour coil, per kg + GST:** Color On Plus **110**; Pragathi Plus **98**; Silver On **95**; JSW Steel (bare AZ150) **92**. A Telugu enquiry was quoted Color On Plus 0.5 mm / 150 GSM at **112.5 + GST per kg**.

**Colour-coated sheet, per square metre + GST:** Color On 0.47 quoted **410–420 + GST** (one call added "+ GFC / loading ₹1.25"); Pragathi 0.47 **380 + GST**. A single 10 ft Color On 47 sheet worked out to **≈ ₹1,383**. In a formal offer, **Color On Plus Sky Blue 0.6/150 GSM = ₹540/sqm** vs a competitor's ₹520 (which was actually **Radiance**, not Color On Plus); JSW flashing quoted ₹550 vs competitor ₹250.

**Tata welding rod (Electra):** net **275**, i.e. **275 + tax ≈ 320–325 including**; for 100-carton bulk, **315–320 including**; a 5% discount off 285 → **270**. Competitor "best" brands run **340–350**. **Cutting wheel** 4 inch **₹15** (5 inch +₹6–7); **1 inch screw ≈ ₹3**.

**Polycarbonate:** Lexon 2 mm = **850 + GST per square metre**.

**Puff sheet:** no flat rate — "normal rate-ன்றது கிடையாது, ஒவ்வொன்னும் different ஆகும்" [there's no standard rate, each is different]; indicative band **₹1,300 / 1,400 / 1,550 per sqm** by thickness/colour/brand.

**Commercial terms:** GST always extra; **transport and loading charged separately** ("transport-க்கு separate-கா amount collect చేస్తాం", "loading charges தனியா வரும், GST தனியா வரும்"). Credit is tight: **cash-and-carry / bill-to-bill** is the norm and "credit-லாம் குடுக்க மாட்டாங்க sir" [they won't give credit] — sales reps push customers to **30 days** and warn against 45-day and risky payers.

## Objection Playbook
- **"Just give me a normal/flat rate for puff / poly."** Don't. Anchor on requirement first: "நீங்க requirement குடுத்தீங்கன்னா அதுக்கு ஏத்த மாதிரி check பண்ணுவோம்" [give the requirement and we'll check accordingly] — capture thickness, colour, quantity, sizes, then quote.
- **"Another vendor is ₹20/sqm cheaper."** Expose the grade gap. In the VDG offer call the cheaper ₹520 was **Radiance**, not Color On Plus: "they have quoted for Radiance brand, this is not Radiance... 15-year warranty, that's why the price differs." Sell **warranty and brand**, not price.
- **"Give me 45 days credit."** Resist: "30 days try பண்ணி பாருங்க" [try for 30 days], and flag doubtful payers privately ("அவனுக்கு ஜவ்வா இழுப்பான்" — he'll drag the payment).
- **"Your welding rod is a new/unknown brand."** Lead with price + quality + Tata name + service: "Tata-ல quality issue வரப்போறது கிடையாது... metal problem வந்தா Tata-காரனே வந்து பார்த்து face பண்ணுவான்" [no quality issue with Tata, and if there's a problem Tata's own man comes and handles it]. Give **one free sample packet** to a *known good* customer only.
- **"Should I buy a roll-forming machine or just deal?"** Advice given: don't over-invest; "வாங்கி stock வச்சு வித்துட்டு போயிடலாம்" [just buy, stock and sell]. Margins on manufacturing are thin (₹4–5/kg) and machines get surrendered.
- **Stock not ready / lead time.** Be honest: "7–10 working days confirmation-க்கு அப்புறம்"; match part-quantities from stock and flag "balance quantity match பண்றதுக்கு time ஆகும், incoming எடுத்துட்டு வரணும்."
- **Delivery/unloading disputes (Porter driver won't unload).** Resolve by absorbing/adjusting: "என்ன charges-ஓ என் account-ல add பண்ணி... New Hindustan-ல வாங்கிக்கங்க" [add the charge to my account]; note it hits the crayon wallet.

## Effective Lines (openings, discovery, closing, follow-up)
**Openings / identity:** "நம்ம company பேர் வந்து Crayon Roofing... JSW Color On Plus" [our company is Crayon Roofing]. For outbound: "இங்க Chennai-ல crayon கேள்விப்பட்டிருக்கீங்களா? crayon roofing?" then warm rapport ("ஞாபகம் வச்சுருக்கீங்களே", "எப்படி இருக்கீங்க sir").

**Discovery:** "உங்களுக்கு என்ன thickness, என்ன color, எவ்வளவு quantity தேவைப்படுது?" [what thickness, colour, quantity do you need?]; "roof-கா wall-கா?" [roof or wall?]. Establish current supplier and brand: "இப்ப எங்க sheet எடுத்து பண்றீங்க?" [where do you buy sheet now?].

**Value framing:** distinguish branded/warranty vs bare/cheap; "ரெண்டுமே ஒரே product தான், ஆனா Silveron branded, warranty கிடைக்கும்" [both are the same base product but Silveron is branded and has warranty].

**Closing / next step (the standard move):** route to WhatsApp — "இந்த number-க்கு hi-ன்னு போட்டு requirement அனுப்பி விடுங்க, நான் quotation போட்டு அனுப்பிடுறேன்" [send 'hi' to this number with your requirement, I'll send a quotation]; "sample அடிச்சு பாத்துட்டு சொல்லுங்க" [test the sample and tell me]; for bulk, "MD கிட்ட பேசி கொஞ்சம் குறைப்பேன்" [I'll check with MD and reduce it a bit].

**Follow-up:** capture name and promise a callback: "நான் check பண்ணிட்டு உங்களுக்கு call பண்றேன்"; leave the door open — "ஏதாவது தேவைன்னா call பண்றேன், place list அனுப்பிச்சு விடுறேன்" [I'll send the price list].

## Common Call Scenarios
1. **Inbound web lead** (found on website/Google/YouTube) for puff, polycarbonate, or colour roofing → discovery → "send requirement on WhatsApp, quotation follows," price deferred to MD.
2. **Coil price enquiry** — per-kg + GST quote across the brand ladder, bulk (ton/100-carton) discount, MD approval for final.
3. **Competitor benchmarking** — customer waves a cheaper Excel/screenshot quote; rep exposes it as a lower grade (Radiance/Asian) or missing warranty.
4. **Outbound Tata cross-sell** to welding shops/fabricators — welding rod, screws, wheels; free sample packet to trusted customers.
5. **Stock/lead-time** — what green/CFG is on the floor now vs 7–10 day incoming.
6. **Order confirmation + payment gate** — "material வேற godown-ல இருந்து எடுத்துட்டு வருவாங்க, 2–3 hours ஆகும்; payment confirm பண்ணுங்க" (payment before dispatch from another lot).
7. **Logistics/GST compliance** — crane/vehicle turning space, unloading charges, delivery-address GST (Form 6 / additional place of business). Internal ops, not sales training.

## Coaching Notes for New Joinees
- **Never quote puff/poly/coated sheet blind.** Get thickness + colour + quantity + sizes first; there is no single "normal rate."
- **Know the ladder cold:** Color On Plus (15-yr warranty) > Silveron > JSW Steel bare (no warranty) > Pragathi > Radiance (no 15-yr) > Asian. When someone is "cheaper," find out *which grade*.
- **Always add GST, transport and loading** — never imply an all-in price you can't honour.
- **Route to WhatsApp** ("hi" → requirement → quotation/brochure/catalog) and log the customer name; most closes happen after the quote.
- **Defer final price to MD/Senthil/Yogesh** but give an honest indicative band so the customer stays engaged.
- **Samples are currency:** carry 4–5 welding-rod packets; give a *full free packet* only to a known good customer — not scattered loose pieces.
- **Protect cash:** default to cash-and-carry / bill-to-bill; push 30 days; quietly flag slow payers before promising credit.
- **Sell Tata on service:** price-competitive, brand quality, and a company rep who shows up if there's a problem.
- **Be honest on stock/lead time** rather than over-promising; part-ship from floor stock and set expectations on incoming.
